amends.section: roster (the weak-Llama judge slot, previously substituted by amendment 1)

what_changed: the weak-Llama judge slot is DROPPED entirely; the roster proceeds at 6 judges (4 continuing + google/gemma-3n-E4B-it + Qwen/Qwen3.7-Max under its inclusion rule) on the frozen protocol's pre-registered 6-judge grid (29,520 main judgment slots at configuration A)
why: persistent provider-side unavailability, converted to a drop by owner decision per roster.new_judge_failure_rule. Amendment 1's substitute meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-Turbo is catalog-listed but NOT serverless-accessible on this account: the live canary abandoned all 83 attempted calls with 'Unable to access non-serverless model' (E:/selvarath-archive/phase3-2026-08-18/phase3_canary_error_log.jsonl), and direct one-token probes of both remaining catalog Llama-3-8B variants (meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct, meta-llama/Llama-3-8b-chat-hf) were refused with the same error. No serverless weak-Llama exists on the provider.
consequences: the Llama within-family descriptive pair dissolves; the gemma pair (gemma-3n-E4B vs gemma-4-31B) and the continuous capability anchor carry the capability axis

the capability-slope secondary remains estimable with a p-value (6 rostered judges meets the protocol's >= 6 non-estimability threshold exactly; if any further judge drops, the slope becomes estimate-and-plot only per the frozen rule)

the manifest is rebuilt for the 6-judge roster under a fresh execution identity; the 464 canary cells completed before the STOP keep their store rows and are skipped on resume (cell keys are roster-independent)
canary and main slot totals move to the frozen 6-judge tables: canary 1,440, main 29,520

owner_authorization.channel: direct chat, 2026-08-18, enumerated-choice prompt in the session UI
owner_authorization.companion_decision: canary cap raised 40 -> 60 USD in the same exchange (selection label 'Raise to $60 (Recommended)'); spend context presented: 12.25 USD accounted at 464/1,680 slots

note: Append-only. The abandoned-cell-rate STOP that surfaced this was the supervisor discipline working as designed: a non-benign halt reason came to the orchestrating session for review within minutes.
